about.title: Tiburon Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Tiburon is a small place, and the public record reflects that: in 2025 the town logged four injury collisions, six people hurt, and no traffic deaths. Still, losing someone never happens on a schedule or only where statistics point. A fatal crash on Tiburon Boulevard, a fall at a Paradise Drive property, a medical mistake at a facility outside town, or a defective product used at home can all lead a Marin County family to ask what comes next. Under California law, a wrongful death claim is a civil action, separate from any criminal case, brought first by a spouse, domestic partner, or children, and then by certain dependents or heirs. It can cover funeral and burial costs, the financial support the person would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. LawProactive is not a law firm. We are a free service that connects Tiburon families with an independent attorney who handles these cases on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery.

whyChoose.title: What Tiburon Families Should Know Before Filing

items.title: Only certain people can file
items.desc: California puts a spouse or domestic partner and children first in line, followed by certain dependents and heirs. An attorney can sort out who in your family has standing before anything is filed.

items.title: The clock is usually two years
items.desc: Most claims must be brought within two years of the date of death, and the window is shorter when a city, county, or state agency may be responsible. Early guidance protects that deadline.

items.title: Losses are broader than the funeral bill
items.desc: Recoverable losses include burial expenses, the income and support your loved one would have provided, and the love, companionship, and guidance your family lost. Each of these is weighed separately.

items.question: The crash happened on Tiburon Boulevard near Route 131. Does it matter if a public agency was involved?
items.answer: It can matter a great deal. When a road design, signal, or maintenance issue involving a government entity is part of the picture, California requires a formal claim much sooner than the usual two-year deadline. An attorney can review the collision report and determine whether that shorter timeline applies to your family.

items.question: There is a criminal case against the driver. Do we have to wait for it to finish?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action and moves on its own track, separate from any prosecution. The outcome of the criminal case does not decide your civil claim, though evidence gathered in one may be useful in the other.

items.question: What does it cost to speak with an attorney through LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free connection service, not a law firm, and the independent attorneys in our network work on contingency. That means no fee unless there is a recovery for your family.
